title: Valkey connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Valkey instance's settings, served by loams-connector-kv's Redis implementation under the `valkey` target profile (CN2 Task 14). The source reads the keyspace by SCAN (`source_mode: keys`, the default) or a stream through a consumer group (`source_mode: stream`, or whenever `stream` is set); the sink SETs or HSETs by a key template, or XADDs, or PUBLISHes. `password` is the name of a secret in the namespace's secret store (D189), never the password itself.

url.description: redis://host[:port][/db] or rediss://… for TLS. Credentials in the URL are refused.

password.description: The name of the secret holding the ACL password.

source_mode.description: keys (SCAN and typed reads) or stream (XREADGROUP).

poll_interval_ms.description: Start a new SCAN pass this long after the last one finished; without it the keyspace is read once.

stream.description: The stream key the source reads, or the sink XADDs to.

streams.description: More stream keys for the source, one split each.

consumer_group.description: The consumer group; loams-<instance> when omitted.

consumer_name.description: The consumer name; the instance name when omitted.

start_id.description: Where a new consumer group starts: 0 (the whole stream) or $ (new entries only).

ack_mode.description: after-ack: XACK after the Fabric acknowledges (at least once). on-read: XREADGROUP NOACK (at most once).

block_ms.description: How long XREADGROUP blocks for new entries.

pending_idle_ms.description: Claim (XAUTOCLAIM) entries other consumers left pending this long.

sink_mode.description: xadd, set, hset or publish; xadd when `stream` is set, else set.

key.description: The upsert key of set and hset: a template with {subject}, {ce_id}, {type}, {source} or {<extension>} (CN1's `key_template` is accepted too).

key_template.description: The key of set and hset, with {subject}, {ce_id}, {type}, {source} or {<extension>}.

field_template.description: hset: the field the event's data goes to; without it the data's JSON object is the hash.

ttl_seconds.description: set: the keys' time to live.
